sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Front Office is the hotel's most important module — it manages the guest's complete journey from first contact (check-in) to last contact (check-out & billing).

In Analysis HMS the Front Office Module handles guest registration, room assignment, folio (bill) management, in-house guest tracking, check-out settlement and all related reports. This training manual teaches front desk staff to operate the system step by step.

GUEST JOURNEY (Training Flow):
Reservation/Enquiry → Guest Arrival → Registration (GRC) → Room Assign → Check-In → Stay (charges post, room change, folio merge) → Check-Out → Bill Settlement → Bill Print → Guest History

sections.title: 3. Master Module — Setup & Configuration
sections.intro: Master setup happens once — defining the property's rooms, rates, sources and parameters. Front desk needs this only for coordination, entries are mainly administered.

subsections.title: 3.1 FOM Parameter
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Fom Parameter
subsections.paragraph: Global settings of the Front Office Module — check-in/check-out time, tax rules, folio printing rules, GRC format parameters etc. These control the behaviour of the entire module.

subsections.title: 3.2 Business Source
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Business Source
subsections.paragraph: Where is business coming from – Walk-In, Phone, WhatsApp, OTA (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com), Corporate etc. On every check-in, business source is selected, after which Revenue Source Report is created.

subsections.title: 3.3 Guest Status
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Guest Status
subsections.paragraph: Define guest categories — Regular, VIP, Corporate Guest, Complimentary etc. Special handling and alerts for VIP guests come from this.

subsections.title: 3.4 Charge Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Charge Master
subsections.paragraph: The charges that can be posted other than room are as follows – Laundry, Restaurant, Mini Bar, Extra Bed, Late Checkout. These charges are posted in the guest folio.

subsections.title: 3.5 Plan Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Plan Master
subsections.paragraph: Room plans — EP (sir room), CP (room + breakfast), MAP (breakfast + dinner), AP (all meals). The rate structure and included meals of the plan are defined here.

subsections.title: 3.6 Room Features
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Room Features
subsections.paragraph: Room's special features — Sea View, Balcony, Jacuzzi, Connecting Door. These have been attached to Room Master.

subsections.title: 3.7 Room Category
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Room Category
subsections.paragraph: Room types defined – Deluxe, Super Deluxe, Suite, Executive. Each category's rate, occupancy (multiper) and revenue code are set here. This is the basis of all rates and occupancy reports.

subsections.title: 3.8 Room Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Room Master
subsections.paragraph: Every physical room entry — room number, category, floor, building, features and QR code. Room QR generator is also distributed from here (for housekeeper QR login).

rows: Is the room active or not?

subsections.title: 3.9 Booking Source
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Booking Source
subsections.paragraph: Where to book the reservation — Direct, Agent, Corporate, OTA. Different from Business Source: It tracks the booking channel.

subsections.title: 3.10 Building Master
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Front Office ▶ Building Master
subsections.paragraph: Define buildings in a multi-building property — Main Block, Annex, Service Wing. Rooms are distributed across these buildings.

subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ CheckIn List

subsections.title: 4.6 Add New Profile
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Add New Profile

subsections.title: 4.7 Room Change (from CheckIn List)
subsections.paragraph: Guest room change required: CheckIn List → guest select → Room Change → new room (vacant must be cleaned) → reason → save. The old room is becoming vacant, the folio is being shifted to the new room. History is mentioned in 'Room Change History' report.
steps: Open the CheckIn List
Click the Room Change action on the guest row
Select a new room from available rooms
Give reason (optional) and save

subsections.title: 4.8 Ammend Stay (Date/Rate Change)
subsections.paragraph: If the guest extends/shortens the stay or the rate changes: CheckIn List → Ammend Stay → new departure date or rate → update. Nights are auto-recalculated and room charges in the folio are adjusted.
steps: CheckIn List → select the guest
Click Ammend Stay
Enter the new departure date / rate
Save — the difference will be posted to the folio

sections.title: 5. Transactions Module — Billing & Folio
sections.intro: All billing-related work at check-out time or during the stay. Folio = the guest's bill ledger, where room charges, POS charges and payments are all posted.

subsections.title: 5.1 Bill Reprint
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Bill Reprint
subsections.paragraph: Reprint an old printed bill — keep the guest copy or issue a duplicate. Enter Year + Bill No. → Search → details → Print. If the bill was wrong, a new bill is made after re-settlement.
steps: Select the For Year
Enter the Bill No.
Search — bill details load hongi
Click Bill Print (duplicate copy)

subsections.title: 5.2 Bill Re-Settlement
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Bill Re-Settlement
subsections.paragraph: If there is a mistake in the settled bill (wrong payment mode, amount, or guest returns) — a new settlement is made by reversing the old settlement. Select Room/folio → load old settlement → modify → re-settle.

rows: Which room's bill has to be re-settled?

subsections.title: 5.3 Misc Payment / Rectification
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Misc Payment /Rect.
subsections.paragraph: Non-guest payments or corrections — expense sheet entry: cash received/paid outside the folio, petty cash, rectification entries. Shows in the cashier report.

rows: In whose head should I post?

subsections.title: 5.4 Merge Folio
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Merge Folio
subsections.paragraph: Combine separate folios of multiple rooms of one guest/family into one — one bill at checkout. E.g. Room 101 and 102 both for the same guest – one bill by merging both the folios.
steps: Open the Merge Folio screen
By selecting master folio (which has to be merged)
Select the folios to merge
Confirm — all charges will move to the master folio

subsections.title: 5.5 Reverse Merge Folio
subsections.navPath: Front Office ▶ Operations ▶ Reverse Merge Folio
subsections.paragraph: Have you merged by mistake? Reverse Merge separates the folios back — charges go back to their original rooms.
steps: Open Reverse Merge Folio
Select the merged folio
Select which charges to reverse?
Confirm — the folios will be separated

sections.title: 8. Dated Reports Analysis — 01-Sep to 18-Sep-2026 (Live Data + Internal Logic)
sections.intro:
This section has been created by applying date-filter of 01-Sep-2026 to 18-Sep-2026 from live system. Along with every report, its internal logic is given – which table, which join, which date column is used. Screenshots folder: screenshots/05_Reports_Dated/. Detailed logic file: FO_Logic_Explanation_01to18Sep.txt (found along with the manual).

In training, study this section on 3rd day — first Masters (data language), then Operations (guest lifecycle), then these reports with logic.

subsections.title: 8.1 Check In Register (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
Navigation: Front Office > Reports > Check In Register > From 01/Sep/2026 To 18/Sep/2026 > Refresh.

INTERNAL LOGIC: guestfolio JOIN roomocc JOIN guestprof WHERE vdate BETWEEN 01 and 18 Sep, GROUP BY docid+sno1. Advance column = SUM(paycharge.amtcr) WHERE modeset<>'S'. Merged folio shows via mFoliono.

Visible in live data: Guest 'Anurag Kushwaha' (Bageshwar)'s 14+ room group check-in on 01-Sep (rooms 101-1151, rate 2500-3000, checkout 03-Sep) — a perfect example of group booking. Operator audit happens via the USER column.

subsections.title: 8.2 Check Out Register (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC: fom_billdetail WHERE billdate BETWEEN dates. Filters: business source, company, travel agent, payment type. Revenue columns come from revmast (field_type='C', Desk_code='FOM'), EXCLUDING ROFF/DISC/CGSS/SGSS/TOUT special codes.

How many checkouts came from which source — the base of market segment analysis.

subsections.title: 8.3 Cashier Report (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC (payment reconciliation): paycharge JOIN revmast(field_type='P') WHERE RESTCODE='FOM' AND VDate BETWEEN dates. The anti-double-count logic: advance settles (ARRES/ADRES) only when DbtChkIn<>'Yes'; refdocid-linked entries are skipped; CHK voucher comes from a separate query.

NetSale = AmtCr - AmtDr. Mode-wise totals (Cash/UPI/Card) = the cashier's shift-handover reconciliation tool.

subsections.title: 8.4 Cancel Bill Details (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC: fom_billdetail WHERE status='Cancel' AND billdate BETWEEN dates. Bill will never be deleted — just status change + reason. Full audit trail.

Audit point: Who (u_name) is canceling how many bills.

subsections.title: 8.5 Occupancy Report (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC (the most important concept): roomocc WHERE chkindate <= to AND (chkoutdate >= from OR chkoutdate IS NULL) — meaning whoever was in-house during the date range (whether checked in earlier or checked out in between). This is the 'room-nights consumed' report, not just check-ins.

Joins: room_mast(type='RO'), guestprof (nationality/ID), plan_mast (package), subgroup (company/TA), busssource (segment), rate_list (rack rate comparison). DayUse = those with chkindate=chkoutdate.

subsections.title: 8.6 Expected Check Out (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC: guestfolio JOIN roomocc WHERE chkoutdate IS NULL AND depdate BETWEEN dates. The date is set at the time of check-in — night audit thus creates a 'today/those who go' list. depth = expected time.

Front desk action: After seeing this list, keep express checkout ready, confirm folio balance.

subsections.title: 8.7 Complimentary Report (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC: guestprof JOIN roomocc WHERE complimentry='Y' AND chkindate BETWEEN dates. The comp flag sits on the profile; comp rooms use a zero rate or comp revenue code, so they are not double-counted in revenue reports.

Manager audit: who sanctioned the comps.

subsections.title: 8.8 Room Change History (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC (self-join trick): roomocc oldr JOIN roomocc newr ON same folio AND newr.roomno=oldr.newroomno AND newr.sno>oldr.sno, WHERE chngdate BETWEEN dates. On a room change a new row (sno+1) is created and the old row gets newroomno written — the whole chain is traceable.

Columns: old room/type/rate/plan -> new room/type/rate/plan, changedby, reason. Proof for dispute resolution.

subsections.title: 8.9 MIS Room Inventory — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC (live snapshot): total = room_mast WHERE InclCount='Y'; occupied = roomocc WHERE chkoutdate IS NULL with guestfolio+booking+busssource+plan joins; free = total - occupied. RackRate = MAX(rate_list.rate2).

Date filters here are for the live position — in training, the answer to 'how many rooms can we sell today' comes from here.

subsections.title: 8.10 MIS Sale Summary (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC (PIVOT report): revmast heads become columns (EXCLUDE ROFF/DISC/GST/TOUT), paycharge SUM per rev_code per day. Occupancy% = sold/(rooms x days), ADR = RoomRent/room-nights.

The manager's daily revenue dashboard — day-wise for 01-18 Sep.

subsections.title: 8.11 MIS Company Contribution — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC: the start/end date is built from the month input (year+month). Corporate -> guestfolio.company join, otherwise travelagent. paycharge WHERE paycode='RMCH' AND vtype='RC' AND sno=1 — only ROOM RENT room-nights. Day-wise COUNT matrix per company.

Which company is bringing how many room-nights on which day — sales review.

subsections.title: 8.12 MIS Guest Trail — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC: per-folio SUM(paycharge) grouped by type: RoomRent, RoomDisc, ExtraCharge, Tax, Outlet(transfer), CreditAmt. Nights = chkout-chkin (or today-chkin for in-house).

One guest's complete financial journey — the single-window answer for bill disputes.

subsections.title: 8.13 MIS Company wise Analysis — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC: subgroup(Corporate) x guestfolio x paycharge — RoomNights, Guests, GrossRevenue, RoomRent, Outlet transfer, Tax. Amounts are split via CASE paycode.

Corporate account performance review — data for renewal negotiations.

subsections.title: 8.14 MIS Revenue Source — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC (raw SQL): GROUP BY against busssource — SUM(RoomNights), SUM(Guests), SUM(GrossRevenue), SUM(RoomRent), SUM(Outlet), SUM(Tax), ADR = RoomRent/NULLIF(RoomNights,0).

The Business Source master bears fruit here: OTA vs Direct vs Corporate mix — the base of sales strategy.

subsections.title: 8.15 FOM Tax Detail (01-18 Sep) — Logic
subsections.para:
INTERNAL LOGIC: paycharge WHERE paycode IN (CGSS, SGSS, luxury codes) AND VDate BETWEEN dates — tax amounts per voucher/bill. GST slabs 0%/12% based on room rate (7500 threshold rule).

The CA's monthly GST working — output tax on rooms. Excel export option available.

subsections.title: 8.16 Report Date-Logic Cheatsheet
subsections.para: THIS TABLE IS THE CORE OF TRAINING: Same From-To, different thing is measured in every report. Ask the trainee on each report — 'What is the meaning of the date in this report?'

subsections.title: 8.17 Data Flow — Where does your entry appear in the database?
subsections.para: Let the trainee understand this – one click on the screen gets the information written in the database. This puts confidence in the report numbers and makes troubleshooting easier.
